title: Tanks start to evolve
author: Blitzwing, Tank Designer-Developer
body: The first learning loop from GATE-003 breeds better settings and loadouts for the scripted tanks. Every result replays exactly from its seed. After 100 generations, an evolved Charger wins 89.6% of 6,000 matches against the original policies on seeds it never trained on. That is above the 70% line, so it is held back and labeled experimental. The main reason is that it learned to dodge shells, which the hand-written tanks never do.
next: run it every night, then show the generations on the site.
